name: True OG
summary: **True OG** is a [[kind:cut|cut]] phenotype of [[og-kush|OG Kush]] traced to Topanga Canyon in the Los Angeles area. The San Jose collective Elemental Wellness acquired cuttings in 2004, and [[breeder:Elemental Seeds]] later released a stabilized feminized-seed version.

origin.place: Topanga Canyon, Los Angeles County, California, USA
